name: Sawn cross-cut (fleuri, along the bed)
process: The block is sawn with the saw plane parallel to the bedding, so the face lies within one layer and shows its cloudy, flowery plan; then left as sawn, or honed or polished.
processSources: Natural Stone Institute (2022) Dimension Stone Design Manual, chapter 12 'Travertine' (Specification, Product Description, Technical Data), pp. 12-1 to 12-14, https://transparencycatalog.com/assets/uploads/greener-images/12-TRAVERTINE-2022.pdf, Product Description 10.1.2

bedToFace.source: Natural Stone Institute (2022) Dimension Stone Design Manual, chapter 12 'Travertine' (Specification, Product Description, Technical Data), pp. 12-1 to 12-14, https://transparencycatalog.com/assets/uploads/greener-images/12-TRAVERTINE-2022.pdf, Product Description 10.1.2 ('the fleuri cut is parallel to the bedding plane')
bedToFace.conditions: angle between the face and the bedding planes

appearance.text: Fleuri, sometimes called cross cut: a flowery, random pattern.
appearance.source: Natural Stone Institute (2022) Dimension Stone Design Manual, chapter 12 'Travertine' (Specification, Product Description, Technical Data), pp. 12-1 to 12-14, https://transparencycatalog.com/assets/uploads/greener-images/12-TRAVERTINE-2022.pdf, Product Description 10.1.2

appearance.text: A uniform appearance with larger, irregular holes; the cut of the Colosseum's travertine.
appearance.source: Alberti e Alberti (Tivoli), 'Travertino Romano Classico', technical properties to UNI EN test standards, product page read 2026-09-26, https://marmialberti.it/en/travertino-romano-classico/
appearance.note: the Colosseum attribution is the maker's statement

weakness.text: Strong as cut, but in high-traffic paving holes may appear after installation where thin-walled cavities lie at or near the face; filling them afterwards is accepted practice.
weakness.source: Natural Stone Institute (2022) Dimension Stone Design Manual, chapter 12 'Travertine' (Specification, Product Description, Technical Data), pp. 12-1 to 12-14, https://transparencycatalog.com/assets/uploads/greener-images/12-TRAVERTINE-2022.pdf, Product Description 10.1.2

cutDependence.text: The two cuts give different strength, and the cut the project uses is tested.
cutDependence.source: Natural Stone Institute (2022) Dimension Stone Design Manual, chapter 12 'Travertine' (Specification, Product Description, Technical Data), pp. 12-1 to 12-14, https://transparencycatalog.com/assets/uploads/greener-images/12-TRAVERTINE-2022.pdf, Technical Data 2.3

photograph: No bands: soft clouds of cream and honey, with rounded, irregular voids scattered over the face.
Voids are larger and less aligned than in a vein-cut slab of the same stone.
On a busy floor, thin-walled voids near the face open through it and are later filled.

unverified.reason: No measured void area on a cross-cut face of Roman travertine was found.

sources: Natural Stone Institute (2022) Dimension Stone Design Manual, chapter 12 'Travertine' (Specification, Product Description, Technical Data), pp. 12-1 to 12-14, https://transparencycatalog.com/assets/uploads/greener-images/12-TRAVERTINE-2022.pdf
Alberti e Alberti (Tivoli), 'Travertino Romano Classico', technical properties to UNI EN test standards, product page read 2026-09-26, https://marmialberti.it/en/travertino-romano-classico/
